fields.description:
Revise the T10 (overlay-infra) rubric to partition its durable-infrastructure scope away from transient de-risk experiments. There is no runtime cross-criterion suppression by design, so the boundary must live in T10's own rubric text.

## Work
- Edit `src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_T10.md`: add this scope clause near the top: "This overlay evaluates the DURABLE infrastructure — the IaC/config that persists. Transient, throwaway experiments used to de-risk a mechanism before committing it — their creation, isolation, and teardown — are out of scope here."
- Preserve the existing endpoint-access safety contract: the transient-lifecycle exclusion does not waive T10 b2 for an internet- or untrusted-network-reachable service whose human/admin authentication is unspecified.
- Keep the rubric independent: T10 must not name T15 or assign scope to another overlay.
- Add a balanced packaged live eval corpus at `src/rebar/llm/eval_specs/plan-review-T10.eval.yaml`. Must-not-fire cases cover an explicitly throwaway loopback/private probe with scoped teardown and well-specified durable infrastructure. Must-fire controls cover under-specified durable lifecycle safety and an untrusted-network-reachable transient service with unspecified authentication.
- Add offline shape and text-contract tests in `tests/unit/plan_review/test_criteria_blocking.py`; these lock the exact scope clause, the safety qualifier, rubric independence, and the balanced eval-case labels. Agentic finding behavior is proved separately by the live criterion eval, not by these unit tests.
- Regenerate `docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md` from the registry.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The T10 rubric contains the exact durable-infrastructure scope clause.
- [ ] The T10 rubric preserves b2 for an untrusted-network-reachable transient service with unspecified human/admin authentication.
- [ ] The T10 rubric does not name T15.
- [ ] The T10 rubric does not assign scope to another overlay.
- [ ] `rebar criteria eval T10 --runs 3` reports pass for the scoped throwaway private-probe case.
- [ ] `rebar criteria eval T10 --runs 3` reports pass for the fully specified durable-infrastructure case.
- [ ] `rebar criteria eval T10 --runs 3` reports finding for the under-specified durable-lifecycle case.
- [ ] `rebar criteria eval T10 --runs 3` reports finding for the untrusted-network transient-service case.
- [ ] `rebar explain T10` renders the durable-infrastructure scope clause.
- [ ] The regenerated T10 section in `docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md` renders the durable-infrastructure scope clause.

## Testing
- Run `.venv/bin/pytest tests/unit/plan_review/test_criteria_blocking.py -q`.
- Run `.venv/bin/rebar criteria eval T10 --runs 3`.
- Run `.venv/bin/python -m rebar.llm.plan_review.registry regenerate-criteria-guide`.
- Run `.venv/bin/python -m rebar.llm.plan_review.registry validate-routing`.
- Run `.venv/bin/rebar explain T10` and verify the rendered clause.
